verified_facts.text: The hotel is directly opposite the Schlossgarten park, a few minutes' walk from Stuttgart Central Station.
verified_facts.excerpt: Only a few minutes' walk from Stuttgart Central Station and directly opposite the "Schlossgarten"

verified_facts.text: Across the Schlossgarten park lies the Königstrasse, Stuttgart's central street for shopping and entertainment.
verified_facts.excerpt: Across the park, Stuttgart's central street, the Königstrasse, invites guests for shopping and entertainment.

verified_facts.text: Guests can walk from the hotel to the Königstraße, the Staatsgalerie, the state opera and both the New and Old Castles.
verified_facts.excerpt: you can easily walk to major attractions, including the popular Königstraße shopping strip, the Staatsgalerie, the state opera and both the New and Old Castles in the city center.

verified_facts.text: Le SPA is an 850 square meter spa with a swimming pool, a 24/7 gym, treatments and a bar and bistro.
verified_facts.excerpt: Breathe easy and get comfortable at 850m² Le Spa with swimming pool, 24/7 gym, treatments from head to toe, and a refreshing bar and bistro.

verified_facts.text: The spa's sauna area has a 70 degree sauna, a 90 degree sauna and an infrared cabin alongside the pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: besides the pool, you find an elegant sauna area with 70° + 90° sauna and infrared cabin.

verified_facts.text: At Le SPA guests can swim laps in the heated pool, relax in the sauna or enjoy the sun in the garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax in our sauna, swim your laps in our heated pool or enjoy the sun in our garden.

verified_facts.text: Le SPA treatments include classic massages, hot stone ceremonies, Ayurvedic massages and foot massages.
verified_facts.excerpt: In addition to classic massages and hot stone ceremonies, you can also indulge in Ayurvedic massages or foot massages.

verified_facts.text: All rooms and suites include complimentary access to the 850 square meter spa area with pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: complimentary access to our 850 m² spa area with pool

verified_facts.text: Rooms have contemporary style with views of the green garden or the city, modern furniture and innovative art.
verified_facts.excerpt: Views of the green garden or city view, modern furniture and innovative art will take you upon a discovery journey of Le Méridien Stuttgart.

verified_facts.text: The largest suites have a separate living room, library and conference space, with an open fireplace or conservatory.
verified_facts.excerpt: Separate living room, library + conference space: spend quality time with family and friends at the open fire-place or conservatory, or host an exclusive dinner or meeting.

verified_facts.text: Bathroom amenities are by MALIN + GOETZ.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a Le Méridien exclusive with our bathroom amenities by MALIN + GOETZ.

verified_facts.text: Through the Unlock Art program, hotel guests get free entry to the Staatsgalerie Stuttgart by showing their room key.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hotel guests get free access to the art exhibitions by presenting their room key of Le Méridien Hotel Stuttgart.

verified_facts.text: The Staatsgalerie Stuttgart, the hotel's Unlock Art partner, holds 800 years of art on 9000 square meters of exhibition space.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Staatsgalerie Stuttgart, Unlock Art™ partner of Le Méridien Stuttgart, hosts 800 years of art on 9000 m² of exhibition space.

verified_facts.text: The Mercedes-Benz Museum is 10 minutes by car from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover the impressive Mercedes Benz Museum which is only 10 minutes by car from Le Méridien Stuttgart.

verified_facts.text: The Porsche Museum and Mercedes-Benz Museum are reachable by public transport from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: For automobile enthusiasts, the Porsche Museum and Mercedes-Benz Museum are easily accessible by public transport.

verified_facts.text: The restaurant serves a Sunday brunch with live cooking stations and an a la carte dinner menu of regional and international specialties.
verified_facts.excerpt: an exclusive Sunday brunch (12:00–15:00) with live cooking stations and drinks, and an à la carte dinner menu featuring regional and international specialties.

verified_facts.text: Bar Lillet is named after the house aperitif Lillet and serves cocktails, selected wines and local beer.
verified_facts.excerpt: Named after the house aperitif - Lillet, a French aperitif that already inspired Bond author Ian Fleming

verified_facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours a day.
verified_facts.excerpt: Work out in our well-equipped hotel gym, which is open 24/7.

verified_facts.text: The pool has daily kids splash time.
verified_facts.excerpt: Please note our Kids splash time daily until 1.00 PM.

verified_facts.text: Pets are welcome, up to two per room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, pets are welcome at Le Méridien Stuttgart. Up to 2 pets are allowed per room.

verified_facts.text: The meeting foyer has a spiral staircase.
verified_facts.excerpt: Highlight: the meeting foyer with a noble spiral staircase is the perfect gathering place.

verified_facts.text: From Stuttgart Airport, the S2 or S3 train runs to Stuttgart Hauptbahnhof in about 30 minutes, followed by a short walk through the castle park.
verified_facts.excerpt: The journey time is approximately 30 minutes. After a short walk through the castle park, you can reach Hotel Le Méridien via the pedestrian bridge.

verified_facts.text: The hotel holds Green Key certification.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Green Key Certified
